parameters.name: exposureUs
parameters.label: Exposure (us, 0=leave)
parameters.description: Applied through the camera device layer before grabbing; 0 leaves the current exposure unchanged. Cameras without exposure support fail deterministically.

parameters.name: gainDb
parameters.label: Gain (dB, -1=leave)
parameters.description: Applied through the camera device layer before grabbing; -1 leaves the current gain unchanged.

items.description: Acquire a frame lease from the continuous CameraFrameHub. Latest reuses the newest frame; Next waits for a newer sequence.
Select one camera image from a synchronized FrameSet without cloning the underlying frame.
Issue one synchronization-group Action Command, collect one new frame from every member camera, and output a workflow-owned FrameSet with measured skew.

parameters.name: sampleIndex
parameters.label: Sample Index
parameters.description: Zero-based sample identifier. The same mode, settings and index reproduce the same image.

parameters.name: offsetStepX
parameters.label: X Shift per Sample
parameters.description: Horizontal translation per sample index in sequence mode.

parameters.name: offsetStepY
parameters.label: Y Shift per Sample
parameters.description: Vertical translation per sample index in sequence mode.

parameters.name: angleStepDeg
parameters.label: Angle Step
parameters.description: Rotation added per sample index in sequence mode.

parameters.name: randomSeed
parameters.label: Random Seed
parameters.description: Fixed seed for repeatable pseudo-random positions.

parameters.name: maxOffsetX
parameters.label: Maximum X Shift
parameters.description: Random horizontal shift is selected from this symmetric range.

parameters.name: maxOffsetY
parameters.label: Maximum Y Shift
parameters.description: Random vertical shift is selected from this symmetric range.

parameters.name: maxAngleDeg
parameters.label: Maximum Angle
parameters.description: Random angle is selected from the symmetric range -value..+value.

items.description: Generate a large test image with a fixed-size pattern. The pattern can stay fixed, follow a sample-index sequence, use repeatable seeded random offsets, or choose a new valid random placement on every run. Sequence and seeded placements are minimally translated into the image when needed; random-each-run placements are resampled instead.

parameters.name: samplesJson
parameters.label: Pose Pairs JSON
parameters.description: {samples:[{robot:{x,y,thetaDeg},vision:{x,y,thetaDeg}},...]}; at least four diverse planar pose pairs with distinct robot poses, at most 1000.

parameters.name: angularWeight
parameters.label: Angular Weight (translation units/radian)
parameters.description: Translation-equivalent weight for angular closure residuals. Adjust to the characteristic working distance; default 50 preserves prior behavior.

parameters.name: targetFrame
parameters.label: Transform Target Frame
parameters.description: Blank defaults to RobotTool for eye-in-hand, RobotBase for eye-to-hand.

items.description: Numerically solve planar SE(2) closure for eye-in-hand or eye-to-hand pose pairs. Requires rotation coverage and translation span in both robot and vision samples, rejects duplicate robot poses, and limits input to 1000 pairs. Angular residual weight is configurable in translation units per radian. Reports per-sample translation and angle errors with separate worst indexes, coverage and optional residual gates. Outputs Pose2D and composable Transform2D. Planar only — no 3D hand-eye.

parameters.name: calibrationDataJson
parameters.label: Views JSON
parameters.description: {imageWidth,imageHeight,views:[{objectPoints:[[X,Y,Z],...],imagePoints:[[u,v],...]}]}; provide at least 3 varied views. Connected calibrationDataJson takes precedence. Prefer the Calibration Wizard / Hand-Eye Wizard (Devices → Calibration → Intrinsics) to accumulate and gate views.

parameters.name: maxViewRms
parameters.label: Max Per-View Reprojection RMS (px, 0=off)
parameters.description: Pre-fit planar homography RMS gate; only applies to planar target views.

parameters.name: maxPoseViewRms
parameters.label: Max Pinhole Pose View RMS (px, 0=off)
parameters.description: Gate the fitted-K per-view reprojection. It is unavailable when native polynomial distortion is active because that model is not included in this pinhole-only check.

items.description: JLVision native polynomial camera calibration from supplied correspondences, accumulated calibration.detectBoard views, or the guided Calibration Wizard session API. Requires at least three varied views and limits input to 500 views/100000 points. viewStats reports per-view coverage and planar/pinhole reprojection RMS/max; maxViewRms, maxPoseViewRms, and maxRms optionally gate acceptance. The pinhole pose metric is not used as an outlier gate when native polynomial distortion is active. No fisheye/telecentric model.

Extract a complete isolated chessboard inner-corner or symmetric circle grid with JLVision. Reports blurVariance (Laplacian), coverage, and a Pass/Warn/Fail quality verdict with guidance. Optional minBlurVariance/minCoverage gates plus rejectWeakViews skip appending failed views. Append up to 100 views into calibrationDataJson for cameraIntrinsics or the Calibration Wizard.

parameters.name: assetId
parameters.label: Calibration Asset ID
parameters.description: Optional immutable calibration asset provenance.

parameters.name: maxRmse
parameters.label: Maximum Calibration RMSE (0=off)
parameters.description: Fail the node when the fit RMSE exceeds this value; 0 disables the gate.

parameters.name: maxPointError
parameters.label: Maximum Point Error (0=off)
parameters.description: Fail the node when any calibration pair residual exceeds this value; 0 disables the gate.

parameters.name: pairsJson
parameters.label: Calibration Pairs JSON
parameters.description: Four or more image/world point pairs. Nine points are recommended for MVP validation.

items.description: Coordinate-normalized, rank-revealing least-squares planar homography from image coordinates to a named target frame. Requires at least four finite, spatially distributed pairs; reports per-pair residuals and supports optional RMSE and maximum-point-error gates. Singular or poorly conditioned geometry fails deterministically.

parameters.name: binarize
parameters.label: Binarize
parameters.description: auto=Otsu; fixed uses Threshold; direct treats every non-zero pixel as foreground.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.label: Threshold
parameters.description: Used when Binarize = fixed threshold.

parameters.name: invert
parameters.label: Dark Objects
parameters.description: Treat dark-on-light as foreground.

parameters.name: maxPoints
parameters.label: Point Budget
parameters.description: Contours are evenly subsampled to this budget so graph data stays bounded.

items.description: Extract contours with hierarchy (external/holes). Returns a Contour list; an empty result is found=false, not a failure. Binarize before extraction or rely on Otsu.
Filter an existing Contour list by area, circularity, hierarchy and a position window (bounding-box center inside the window). Composable with contour.extract; no re-extraction.

Create one subpixel contour from [x,y] pairs, preserving point order. Connected JSON overrides the parameter. Empty or singleton input returns found=false. Limits: 2 MiB JSON, 20000 points, finite coordinates within +/-100000000 px. Consecutive duplicates, and repeated endpoints for closed contours, are removed.

parameters.name: index
parameters.label: Index
parameters.description: Used when Select = by index (clamped).

items.description: Compute derived contour geometry (centroid, min-area rotated rectangle, solidity, extent, aspect ratio, equivalent diameter) and emit a DetectionList for the collection/loop nodes. Empty input is an error.

Compose A:S->M with B:M->T to produce S->T, enforcing frame/unit compatibility and rejecting singular or non-finite transforms. For image geometry, compose roi.transform (ReferenceImage->CurrentImage) as A with image.crop (CurrentImage->CropImage) as B. Emits frames, determinant and JSON diagnostics.

parameters.name: sourceFrame
parameters.label: Source Frame
parameters.description: Frame the transform maps from; must be non-empty.

parameters.name: targetFrame
parameters.label: Target Frame
parameters.description: Frame the transform maps to; must be non-empty.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.label: Unit
parameters.description: Use px for image-space transforms used by image.warpAffine or caliper measurement; use mm/cm/m for engineering coordinates.

parameters.name: x
parameters.label: X Translation
parameters.description: Finite translation along the target frame X axis.

parameters.name: y
parameters.label: Y Translation
parameters.description: Finite translation along the target frame Y axis.

parameters.name: angleDeg
parameters.label: Rotation
parameters.description: Finite counter-clockwise rotation in degrees.

items.description: Create a rigid 2D transform between named engineering or pixel coordinate frames with strict finite-value, frame and unit validation. Emits translation/rotation scalars, frame names, unit and JSON diagnostics (including determinant).

Distance between two frame-aware points, only when frame and unit match exactly. Emits a Measurement, scalar distance, signed dx/dy and JSON diagnostics; mismatched or non-finite points fail deterministically.

parameters.name: x
parameters.label: X
parameters.description: Used when the X input is not connected.

parameters.name: y
parameters.label: Y
parameters.description: Used when the Y input is not connected.

parameters.name: frame
parameters.label: Frame
parameters.description: Must be non-empty. When a frame tree is connected, the name must exist on that tree. There is no global frame registry.

items.description: Create a coordinate-aware reference point. Optional X/Y inputs override the constants so a match or detection can drive the point. Values must be finite. The frame must be non-empty; a connected frame tree checks it against known frames.

parameters.name: x
parameters.label: X
parameters.description: Used when the X input is not connected.

parameters.name: y
parameters.label: Y
parameters.description: Used when the Y input is not connected.

parameters.name: thetaDeg
parameters.label: Theta
parameters.description: Used when the theta input is not connected. The output angle is normalized to (-180, 180].

parameters.name: frame
parameters.label: Frame
parameters.description: Must be non-empty. When a frame tree is connected, the name must exist on that tree. There is no global frame registry.

items.description: Create a frame-aware 2D pose. Optional X/Y/theta inputs override the constants so a match result can drive the pose. Values must be finite and theta is normalized to (-180, 180]. The frame must be non-empty; a connected frame tree checks it against known frames.

parameters.name: transformsJson
parameters.label: Transforms JSON
parameters.description: Static rigid transforms. Runtime dynamic transforms can still be composed as normal workflow data.

items.description: Build a bidirectional frame graph from validated rigid transforms and resolve transforms by named frame path. Rejects empty, duplicate or non-finite edges deterministically; emits transform/frame counts, the frame list and JSON diagnostics.
Invert a Transform2D and swap source/target frame and units. Validates every matrix element and rejects singular transforms deterministically; emits frame names, determinant and JSON diagnostics.

parameters.name: sourceFrame
parameters.label: Source Frame
parameters.description: Child/tool frame named by the new transform; must differ from the pose frame.

items.description: Interpret a pose expressed in its parent frame as a rigid transform from Source Frame to that parent frame, rejecting a source frame equal to the pose frame. Useful for dynamic Tool->RobotBase transforms. Emits scalars, frames, determinant and JSON diagnostics.

parameters.name: sourceFrame
parameters.label: Source Frame
parameters.description: Frame to resolve from; must exist in the frame tree.

parameters.name: targetFrame
parameters.label: Target Frame
parameters.description: Frame to resolve to; an unreachable target fails deterministically.

items.description: Resolve the shortest transform path in a FrameTree2D, automatically using inverse edges where required. Validates frame names and the resolved transform; emits hop count, frame names, path and JSON diagnostics, and fails when no path exists.

Transform a frame-aware point through another engineering-frame Transform2D with strict frame/unit, finite-value and singularity validation. Emits the point plus scalar x/y, target frame, unit and JSON diagnostics.

Transform a frame-aware pose through another engineering-frame Transform2D with strict frame/unit, finite-value and singularity validation. Emits the pose plus scalar x/y/theta, target frame, unit and JSON diagnostics.
Transform both endpoints of a pixel Line2D into a coordinate-aware line. Validates line degeneracy and transform singularity; emits length, direction angle, frame, unit and JSON diagnostics.

Convert an image-space Point2D into a frame/unit-aware coordinate point through a validated Transform2D. Rejects non-finite points and singular transforms; emits frame, unit and JSON diagnostics alongside the point.
Transform X/Y and local orientation into a named target frame through a validated Transform2D. Rejects non-finite pose values and singular transforms; emits scalars, frame, unit and JSON diagnostics.

Detect local bright/dark deviations using JLVision dynamic threshold. Background comes from the input or a local mean with an odd window. Connect image or domainImage; optional region further limits detection. Output objects are not split.

Grayscale flat-field correction: (image-dark)/(bright-dark)*target. Auto target is mean bright-dark. All gain pixels must exceed minGain. References must match dimensions; byte output clips, real output preserves range.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.label: Exceedance Threshold (0=off)
parameters.description: When > 0, also report the fraction of pixels whose absolute difference reaches this value, the changed-pixel count and an 8-connected change region for downstream region tools.

items.description: Compare aligned grayscale images with JLVision arithmetic. Output is float32; signed mode preserves negative differences, normalized mode reports the illumination ratio in [-1,1]. Mean/stdDev/min/max and a global SSIM-style similarity (whole-image statistics, 1 = identical) are always reported; when threshold > 0 the thresholded change region and changed-pixel count are also emitted. No automatic alignment is performed (use defect.referenceCompare for registration and grading).

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.label: Reference Difference Threshold
parameters.description: Minimum grayscale difference in the source image intensity units; 16-bit grayscale images keep their full 0–65535 range.

parameters.name: registrationTolerance
parameters.label: Registration Tolerance
parameters.description: Search and refine integer reference shifts within +/- this many pixels and keep the best alignment. Search is scored only inside the effective inspection domain (image domain intersected with optional region). 0 disables registration.

parameters.name: maxRegistrationError
parameters.label: Maximum Registration Error (0=off)
parameters.description: Fail inspection if source or any extra reference cannot align below this mean absolute grayscale error inside the inspection domain. Uses source intensity units.

parameters.name: compensation
parameters.label: Illumination Compensation
parameters.description: Least-squares fit of the reference toward the inspected image using only pixels inside the effective inspection domain before differencing (variation-model style).

parameters.name: morphologyOpen
parameters.label: Morphology Open Kernel
parameters.description: Opening kernel applied to the defect mask before splitting; 0 disables, otherwise 3-15 odd.

parameters.name: morphologyClose
parameters.label: Morphology Close Kernel
parameters.description: Closing kernel applied after opening; 0 disables, otherwise 3-15 odd.

parameters.name: variationK
parameters.label: Variation Model K (0=off)
parameters.description: When > 0, a pixel must differ by at least threshold + K * reference standard deviation. With multiple references, deviation is learned per pixel from aligned samples; with one reference, it is estimated locally.

parameters.name: variationWindow
parameters.label: Variation Window
parameters.description: Odd neighborhood for local variation when only one reference image is connected; ignored by a multi-reference model.

items.description: Golden-template defect comparison: connect one to five known-good images with matching dimensions and pixel depth; optional small-shift registration aligns extra samples and the current image inside the inspection domain. Multiple references build a per-pixel mean and sample-standard-deviation model; a single reference uses the legacy local-texture estimate. Optional registration error gating and illumination compensation precede thresholding, morphology, defect splitting, area filtering and minor/major/critical grading. defects JSON lists area and bounding box per defect; referenceSampleCount reports used samples. Bright means image-reference; dark means reference-image. Optional region/domain limits inspection. Threshold includes equality.

Grayscale mean, population deviation, min/max and range over the union of region pixels intersected with the image domain. Overlapping objects count once. Empty selection returns found=false and omits statistics; check found before consuming them.
Read a typed tag through DeviceManager. Returns value, quality and timestamp without exposing protocol SDK objects.

parameters.name: triggerMode
parameters.label: Trigger
parameters.description: Level waits while the condition is true. Rising waits for false-to-true and Falling for true-to-false. The first sample cannot be an edge.

parameters.name: stableMs
parameters.label: Stable Hold
parameters.description: The armed condition must stay true for this long. 0 accepts the first qualifying sample. Cannot exceed Timeout.

parameters.name: qualityMode
parameters.label: Accepted Quality
parameters.description: Samples outside the accepted quality do not match, do not move the edge memory, and do not count toward the stable hold.

parameters.name: onTimeout
parameters.label: On Timeout
parameters.description: Fail throws the existing timeout error. Continue succeeds with matched=false so a downstream branch can handle the miss.

items.description: Poll a device tag until the condition is true, an edge is seen, or the timeout expires. Level is the default and still fails on timeout. Rising, falling, stable-hold, quality, and a matched=false timeout result are optional.

parameters.name: fallbackValue
parameters.label: Fallback Value
parameters.description: Used only when the optional Any input is not connected.

items.description: Write a generic device tag. Connected input wins; otherwise the typed fallback parameter is used.
Write OK/NG + optional X/Y/R as an ordered PLC result transaction: Ready=0, payload, Ready=1.

parameters.name: blurSize
parameters.label: Blur Kernel
parameters.description: Gaussian pre-blur kernel; must be odd (3-15).

parameters.name: refineBand
parameters.label: Refinement Band
parameters.description: Edge points within this radial distance of a candidate are used for the geometric circle refit.

items.description: Detect multiple circles: candidates are refined against Canny edge points with a robust geometric circle fit and ranked by inlier support (not largest radius). Returns found=false when no circle qualifies; circles JSON lists center, radius, RMS error and inliers per circle.

parameters.name: blurSize
parameters.label: Blur Kernel (0=off)
parameters.description: Optional Gaussian pre-blur; must be 0, 3, 5, or 7.

parameters.name: subpixel
parameters.label: Subpixel Chain Points
parameters.description: Refine chain points along the local gradient (parabolic peak interpolation) and include them in the chains JSON, stride-sampled to at most 200 points per chain.

items.description: Canny edge extraction with chain analysis. Supports image-space ROI; returns the binary edge image plus per-chain lengths and bounding boxes (chains JSON, longest first), optionally with subpixel-refined chain points. Thresholds must satisfy 0 <= low <= high <= 255.

Detect multiple lines: collinear segments are clustered and refit with robust total least squares. Returns found=false (instead of failing) when no line qualifies; lines JSON lists every line with length, angle, RMS/max fit error and inlier support. The primary line/length/angle ports carry the longest line.

parameters.name: sampleWidth
parameters.label: Projection Length
parameters.description: The projection width must be odd; even values are rounded up to the next odd value (for example, 4 becomes 5). Length is averaged along the expected edge; larger values smooth local noise but may merge nearby features.

items.description: Subpixel edge location along a search line. Measurements use 8-bit grayscale; UInt16 input is scaled linearly from its full range to 0..255. Optional rigid px-to-px transform maps reference searchLine/endpoint parameters to the current image, including sampling direction. ROI inputs are already in current image coordinates. No edge above the contrast threshold returns found=false.

Choose the true or false path from the Boolean condition input, then converge the paths at a Join. Also emits the condition, the selected branch name (true/false) and JSON diagnostics for run tracing.

parameters.name: delayMs
parameters.label: Delay
parameters.description: Requested wait in milliseconds (0-600000); cancellation stops the wait immediately.

items.description: Wait for the configured duration; cancellation stops the wait immediately. Reports requested and measured elapsed time in JSON diagnostics; out-of-range delays fail deterministically.
Converge selected If/Switch branches. A real incoming branch is required by structured workflow compilation. Emits a JSON diagnostics marker so merged runs remain traceable in node summaries.

parameters.name: maxItems
parameters.label: Maximum Items
parameters.description: Hard item-count limit (1-500); exceeding it fails the loop instead of silently truncating.

items.description: Sequentially execute the structured body once for each DetectionList item in input order. The body receives current index/center/circle/rectangle/x/y and optional confidence/classId; the loop fails when item count exceeds maxItems.

parameters.name: operator
parameters.label: Operator
parameters.description: Used in threshold mode.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.label: Compare Value
parameters.description: Used in threshold mode.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.label: Compare Mode
parameters.description: Threshold compares one value. Inside range checks a closed window and ignores the operator.

parameters.name: tolerance
parameters.label: Tolerance
parameters.description: Absolute band for == and !=. The default 1e-9 preserves the previous equality behavior.

parameters.name: rangeMin
parameters.label: Range Minimum
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound for inside-range mode. Must not exceed Range Maximum.

parameters.name: rangeMax
parameters.label: Range Maximum
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound for inside-range mode.

parameters.name: hysteresis
parameters.label: Hysteresis
parameters.description: Applied only when the previous condition input is connected. There is no memory across runs. 0 disables it.

items.description: Compare a number and branch true or false. Threshold mode keeps the original operators, with a configurable equality tolerance. Inside-range mode checks a closed window. Hysteresis uses the optional previous condition and does not remember state across runs. Emits condition, echoed value, signed margin and JSON diagnostics.
Structured branch join marker. Merges Parallel branch dispositions with any-NG semantics (NG wins) into the run disposition; emits a JSON diagnostics marker for tracing.
Marks the end of a forEach body and returns control to its paired flow.forEach node. It cannot be used as an arbitrary graph jump. Emits a JSON diagnostics boundary marker.
Start two Workflow Core parallel paths. Emits a JSON diagnostics marker; branch scheduling and any-NG disposition merging are handled by the structured runtime.
Set the automatic inspection disposition (OK/NG) for traceability with JSON diagnostics. Inside Parallel branches the value is scoped to its branch and merged at Join with any-NG semantics.

parameters.name: casesJson
parameters.label: Cases (JSON string array)
parameters.description: JSON array of 1-16 non-empty unique case labels; malformed JSON or duplicates fail deterministically.

items.description: Choose one matching path. casesJson entries map in order to case1-case16; unmatched values take the default path and report matched=false. Converge all configured paths at Flow Merge. Emits case count and JSON diagnostics.

parameters.name: maxRetries
parameters.label: Max Retries
parameters.description: Automatic retries for eligible deterministic compute bodies only; cancellation is never retried.

parameters.name: retryDelayMs
parameters.label: Retry Delay
parameters.description: Delay between retry attempts in milliseconds.

items.description: Catch body failures and route to success or error. Automatic retries are limited to linear deterministic built-in Pipeline compute nodes with no declared actions; cancellation is never retried. Connect body/success/error to flow.merge case1/case2/default.

Acute (0-90 deg) and signed (-180..180 deg) angle between two non-degenerate Line2D values, with both line lengths, parallel/perpendicular flags in JSON diagnostics, and overlay lines for visual debugging.

parameters.name: parallelTolerance
parameters.label: Parallel Tolerance
parameters.description: Minimum |determinant| below which lines are rejected as parallel/coincident instead of returning an unstable point.

parameters.name: requireWithinSegments
parameters.label: Require Within Segments
parameters.description: When true, reject intersections that lie outside either finite segment; when false, intersect the infinite lines.

items.description: Intersect two Line2D values with strict parallel/degenerate validation. Reports the point, segment parameters (withinSegments), inter-line angle and a JSON diagnostics payload; optionally requires the crossing to lie inside both finite segments.

Euclidean distance between two finite Point2D values, with signed dx/dy, midpoint, direction angle and JSON diagnostics. Non-finite inputs are rejected deterministically instead of propagating NaN downstream.

parameters.name: outputName
parameters.label: Output Name
parameters.description: Optional ONNX output/layer name; leave empty for the model's default output.

parameters.name: swapRB
parameters.label: Swap Red and Blue
parameters.description: Enable for RGB-trained models such as Ultralytics YOLO (OpenCV loads BGR).

parameters.name: thresholdMode
parameters.label: Threshold Mode
parameters.description: Otsu derives the effective threshold from the spatial anomaly map distribution (suggestedThreshold); scalar outputs always use the manual threshold.

items.description: Run an ONNX anomaly model. A scalar output is compared directly with the manual threshold; a spatial anomaly map ([1,1,H,W] or [1,H,W]) also emits a normalized heatmap resized to the source, the peak score/location and the fraction of map pixels at or above the effective threshold (isAnomaly follows the peak). thresholdMode=otsu uses the Otsu threshold of the map itself as the effective threshold.

parameters.name: outputName
parameters.label: Output Name
parameters.description: Optional ONNX output/layer name; leave empty for the model's default output.

parameters.name: swapRB
parameters.label: Swap Red and Blue
parameters.description: Enable for RGB-trained models such as Ultralytics YOLO (OpenCV loads BGR).

parameters.name: layout
parameters.label: Output Layout
parameters.description: YOLO26-cls ONNX exports [1,C] probabilities with softmax already in the graph; choose yolo26 to skip a second softmax.

parameters.name: letterbox
parameters.label: Letterbox Resize
parameters.description: Preserve aspect with gray (114) padding. Usually off for classifiers.

parameters.name: labels
parameters.label: Class Labels
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated labels in model class order; the count must match the model class count or the field must stay empty.

parameters.name: applySoftmax
parameters.label: Apply Softmax
parameters.description: Ignored when layout=yolo26 (probabilities are already normalized).

parameters.name: topK
parameters.label: Top K
parameters.description: Number of ranked classes in the result JSON (clamped to the class count); values outside 1–100 fail.

parameters.name: minimumConfidence
parameters.label: Minimum Classification Confidence (0=off)
parameters.description: Emit accepted=false when the winning probability is below this threshold. Requires softmax probabilities; 0 disables the gate.

items.description: Run an ONNX image classifier with NCHW float input [1,3,H,W]. Output [1,C] or [1,C,1,1]. layout=scores applies optional numerically stable softmax; layout=yolo26 matches Ultralytics YOLO26-cls ONNX (already softmaxed, probabilities are validated and never re-softmaxed). Label lists must match the class count or be empty; unknown layouts and invalid topK fail deterministically. Emits top-K JSON plus best label/index/confidence, an optional minimum-confidence acceptance signal, winner margin, distribution entropy, class count and JSON diagnostics. No training/evaluation is performed. Tip: set swapRB=true for RGB-trained YOLO models.

parameters.name: outputName
parameters.label: Output Name
parameters.description: Optional ONNX output/layer name; leave empty for the model's default output.

parameters.name: swapRB
parameters.label: Swap Red and Blue
parameters.description: Enable for RGB-trained models such as Ultralytics YOLO (OpenCV loads BGR).

parameters.name: letterbox
parameters.label: Letterboxed Input
parameters.description: Enable for Ultralytics YOLO: preprocess uses gray (114) letterbox AND coordinates are un-padded before mapping to the source.

items.description: Run an ONNX detector. Layout xyxy expects rows [x1,y1,x2,y2,score,classId] as [N,6] or [1,N,6] (YOLO26 end-to-end nms=False export is typically [1,300,6]); layout yolo expects YOLOv8/YOLO26 raw cx,cy,w,h plus per-class scores as [1,C,N]; layout yolov5 adds objectness. Enable letterbox so preprocess pads like Ultralytics and coordinates un-pad correctly. Class-aware NMS is applied here (not embedded).

parameters.name: outputName
parameters.label: Output Name
parameters.description: Optional ONNX output/layer name; leave empty for the model's default output.

parameters.name: swapRB
parameters.label: Swap Red and Blue
parameters.description: Default on for RGB-trained Ultralytics YOLO (OpenCV loads BGR).

parameters.name: protoOutputName
parameters.label: Prototype Output Name
parameters.description: Second ONNX output (mask prototypes). Leave empty with outputName empty to use the model's first two outputs in order.

parameters.name: layout
parameters.label: Output Layout
parameters.description: Expects detection tensor [1,4+nc+32,N] and prototypes [1,32,H,W] (mask dim may differ).

parameters.name: letterbox
parameters.label: Letterboxed Input
parameters.description: Default on: Ultralytics exports assume letterbox preprocess; disable only for stretch-trained custom exports.

items.description: Run Ultralytics YOLO26/YOLOv8 instance-seg ONNX (dual outputs: boxes+coeffs and prototypes). Applies class-aware NMS, composes per-instance masks (sigmoid of coeff·proto, cropped to box; letterbox-aware remap to source), merges into a class-id label mask (classId+1; overlaps last-wins), and returns detections. Not semantic segmentation; not OBB. For keypoints use inference.pose. Embedded-NMS / single-tensor e2e seg exports are unsupported—use raw dual-head ONNX.

parameters.name: outputName
parameters.label: Output Name
parameters.description: Optional ONNX output/layer name; leave empty for the model's default output.

parameters.name: swapRB
parameters.label: Swap Red and Blue
parameters.description: Default on for RGB-trained Ultralytics YOLO (OpenCV loads BGR).

parameters.name: layout
parameters.label: Output Layout
parameters.description: yolo: [1,4+nc+K*D,N] e.g. COCO [1,56,8400]. xyxy: [1,N,6+K*D] e.g. YOLO26 nms=False [1,300,57].

parameters.name: letterbox
parameters.label: Letterboxed Input
parameters.description: Default on: Ultralytics letterbox preprocess and coordinate un-padding.

parameters.name: numKeypoints
parameters.label: Keypoint Count
parameters.description: COCO pose uses 17. Must match the exported model.

parameters.name: keypointDims
parameters.label: Keypoint Dims
parameters.description: 3 = x,y,conf (Ultralytics default); 2 = x,y only.

parameters.name: keypointThreshold
parameters.label: Keypoint Draw Threshold
parameters.description: Keypoints / skeleton bones below this confidence are skipped on the overlay.

parameters.name: drawSkeleton
parameters.label: Draw COCO Skeleton
parameters.description: When numKeypoints=17, draw the standard COCO-17 skeleton on the overlay.

items.description: Run Ultralytics YOLO26/YOLOv8 pose ONNX. layout=yolo decodes the raw multi-candidate head (external class-aware NMS). layout=xyxy matches YOLO26 end-to-end NMS-free rows [x1,y1,x2,y2,score,class,kpts...]. Outputs person boxes, keypoints JSON (x,y,conf in source pixels), and an overlay. Set swapRB=true (default here) and letterbox=true for Ultralytics exports. Custom keypoint topologies work if numKeypoints/keypointDims match; skeleton drawing is COCO-17 only.

parameters.name: outputName
parameters.label: Output Name
parameters.description: Optional ONNX output/layer name; leave empty for the model's default output.

parameters.name: swapRB
parameters.label: Swap Red and Blue
parameters.description: Enable for RGB-trained models such as Ultralytics YOLO (OpenCV loads BGR).

parameters.name: layout
parameters.label: Output Layout
parameters.description: logits keeps legacy multi-channel scores; yolo26-semantic matches Ultralytics YOLO26-sem ONNX where argmax is already in the graph ([1,H,W]).

parameters.name: letterbox
parameters.label: Letterbox Resize
parameters.description: Preserve aspect with gray (114) padding. Enable when the YOLO26-sem export used letterbox.

parameters.name: binaryThreshold
parameters.label: Binary Threshold
parameters.description: Used only for layout=logits with one channel; multi-class logits use per-pixel argmax. Ignored for yolo26-semantic.

parameters.name: lowConfidenceThreshold
parameters.label: Low Confidence Threshold
parameters.description: Fraction of pixels whose winning score is below this value is reported as lowConfidenceFraction. For yolo26-semantic, scores are treated as 1.0.

items.description: Semantic segmentation only. layout=logits: [1,C,H,W] argmax mask. layout=yolo26-semantic: YOLO26-sem ONNX class map [1,H,W]/[H,W]/[1,1,H,W] (argmax already applied). Emits label mask, colour overlay, per-class stats. For YOLO instance masks (yolo26n-seg) use inference.instanceSegmentation.

parameters.name: op
parameters.label: Operation
parameters.description: Strictly one of and/or/xor/not; NOT uses input a only, unknown operations fail.

items.description: Combine boolean results with strict operation validation (NOT uses a only; unknown operations fail instead of defaulting to AND). Feeds flow.result / flow.if for the final OK/NG disposition; emits JSON diagnostics.

parameters.name: subpixelRefine
parameters.label: Subpixel Refinement
parameters.description: Parabolically refine the match translation to subpixel precision. Applied only when the found angle is within 5 degrees (rotated matches keep the integer result).

items.description: NCC rigid registration at fixed scale. Select a distinctive reference patch with margin in the scene. Outputs current-pixel to reference-pixel transform, match angle and patch centre only when found; gate downstream warp on found. Optional subpixel refinement improves translation for near-axis-aligned matches.

parameters.name: templatePath
parameters.label: Template Path
parameters.description: Used only when the template port is not connected.

parameters.name: modelMode
parameters.label: Model Lifecycle
parameters.description: New nodes require an explicitly trained model. Legacy workflows without this setting keep their previous template-image behavior.

parameters.name: binarize
parameters.label: Origin Estimation
parameters.description: Estimates the default origin only. Model features are trained from the original gray image.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.label: Origin Threshold
parameters.description: Used when origin estimation uses a fixed threshold; this does not binarize the shape model.

parameters.name: invert
parameters.label: Dark Foreground
parameters.description: Invert only the automatic foreground used to estimate the origin.

parameters.name: angleRangeDeg
parameters.label: Legacy Angle Range
parameters.description: Compatibility setting for older shape workflows that use an image template directly.

parameters.name: trainingAngleRangeDeg
parameters.label: Training Angle Coverage
parameters.description: Maximum symmetric angle range represented by the trained model. Changing this requires retraining.

parameters.name: searchAngleStartDeg
parameters.label: Search Start Angle
parameters.description: Lower angle bound for this search run. It is clipped to the trained model coverage and does not require retraining.

parameters.name: searchAngleEndDeg
parameters.label: Search End Angle
parameters.description: Upper angle bound for this search run. It is clipped to the trained model coverage and does not require retraining.

parameters.name: searchScaleMinPercent
parameters.label: Search Minimum Scale
parameters.description: Minimum scale for this search run, as a percentage of the trained object size. It is clipped to the trained model coverage.

parameters.name: searchScaleMaxPercent
parameters.label: Search Maximum Scale
parameters.description: Maximum scale for this search run, as a percentage of the trained object size. It is clipped to the trained model coverage.

parameters.name: angleStepDeg
parameters.label: Angle Step
parameters.description: Model training angle step. Smaller steps improve angular coverage at additional model size.

parameters.name: pyramidLevels
parameters.label: Pyramid Levels
parameters.description: 0 selects automatic pyramid depth; 1–8 fixes the coarse-to-fine levels used for training and search. More levels can speed up large-image search but may miss small features.

parameters.name: scaleTolerancePercent
parameters.label: Scale Tolerance
parameters.description: Train and search a symmetric scale range around 100%. Zero keeps fixed-scale matching.

parameters.name: scaleToleranceXPercent
parameters.label: X Scale Tolerance
parameters.description: Independent horizontal scale tolerance for anisotropic shape matching. If either X/Y tolerance is non-zero, these axis values take precedence over uniform Scale Tolerance.

parameters.name: scaleToleranceYPercent
parameters.label: Y Scale Tolerance
parameters.description: Independent vertical scale tolerance for anisotropic shape matching. If either X/Y tolerance is non-zero, these axis values take precedence over uniform Scale Tolerance.

parameters.name: scaleStepPercent
parameters.label: Scale Step
parameters.description: Scale sampling step used when scale tolerance is enabled.

parameters.name: trainingMinSampleFraction
parameters.label: Minimum Sample Fraction
parameters.description: Minimum fraction of aligned samples that must contain a contour feature for it to enter the composite model.

parameters.name: trainingFeatureTolerancePx
parameters.label: Feature Alignment Tolerance
parameters.description: Maximum point distance used to treat contour features from different samples as the same feature.

parameters.name: ignorePolarity
parameters.label: Ignore Polarity
parameters.description: Match the same contour when its light/dark polarity is reversed.

parameters.name: minContrast
parameters.label: Minimum Feature Contrast
parameters.description: Reject weak boundaries while training the shape model.

parameters.name: clutterContrast
parameters.label: Clutter Contrast
parameters.description: Minimum edge contrast counted inside the optional Clutter ROI; must be at least Minimum Feature Contrast.

parameters.name: trainingOriginMode
parameters.label: Training Origin
parameters.description: Use the dominant thresholded component centroid when available; fall back to the selected model region centroid. Model features still use the original grayscale image.

parameters.name: trainingOriginX
parameters.label: Origin X
parameters.description: Used when Training Origin = manual; coordinates are relative to the full training image.

parameters.name: trainingOriginY
parameters.label: Origin Y
parameters.description: Used when Training Origin = manual; coordinates are relative to the full training image.

parameters.name: maxDeformationPx
parameters.label: Maximum Local Deformation
parameters.description: Allow each model point to move locally by up to this many pixels during pose refinement. Uses least-squares adjustment and does not require retraining; 0 disables deformation tolerance.

parameters.name: maxClutterScore
parameters.label: Maximum Clutter Score
parameters.description: When a Clutter ROI is trained, reject candidates whose clutter-region edge score exceeds this value.

parameters.name: scoreUsingClutter
parameters.label: Score Using Clutter
parameters.description: When a Clutter ROI is trained, multiply the native match score by (1 - clutter score). The unadjusted score is also available as nativeScore.

parameters.name: runtimeContrastThreshold
parameters.label: Runtime Contrast Threshold
parameters.description: Minimum average gradient strength (0–255) at matched model features. Zero disables this run-time filter; it does not require retraining.

parameters.name: contrastFractionThreshold
parameters.label: Contrast Fraction Threshold
parameters.description: Minimum run-time feature contrast divided by the trained-image feature contrast, capped at 1. Zero disables this check; it needs the lossless original training image.

parameters.name: engine
parameters.label: Shape Engine
parameters.description: managedChamfer builds a contour model from the template image (templateRoi crop, centre origin) and searches a chamfer distance transform; it ignores trained native models. auto falls back to chamfer only when the native library is unavailable.

parameters.name: chamferTolerancePx
parameters.label: Chamfer Tolerance
parameters.description: Edge distance (px) that still counts as covered model contour. Higher tolerates more occlusion/blur but admits more clutter.

parameters.name: chamferAngleStepDeg
parameters.label: Chamfer Angle Step
parameters.description: Coarse angular sampling for the managed engine; refinement halves the step locally. Angle remains discrete, not continuous.

parameters.name: chamferScaleStepPercent
parameters.label: Chamfer Scale Step
parameters.description: Scale sampling between Search Minimum/Maximum Scale for the managed engine.

parameters.name: chamferMaxModelPoints
parameters.label: Chamfer Max Model Points
parameters.description: Contour points kept after subsampling the template edges; more points are slower but describe finer shape detail.

items.description: JLVision gray-value shape matching with explicit model/search regions, subpixel pose, run-time contrast thresholds, optional bounded local deformation, uniform or independent X/Y scale tolerance, polarity control, native clutter scoring and multi-target suppression. Train up to four equal-size samples; later sample regions follow the first model's pose, then stable XLD contour features are fused into one native composite model by sample frequency. The selected model region limits features without threshold segmentation; the optional Clutter ROI marks nearby image areas where edges should not appear. angle rotates the trained template CCW to align with the scene; scale values are relative to trained width and height. The managedChamfer engine is a cross-platform edge-distance alternative (coverage + distance score, partial-occlusion tolerant, multi-target); it is conceptually in the HALCON shape-model / PatMax direction but not parity: discrete angle/scale, no polarity, XLD refinement, deformation or clutter model.

parameters.name: templatePath
parameters.label: Template File
parameters.description: Used when the template input port is not connected (absolute path, or relative to the host working directory).

parameters.name: angleRangeDeg
parameters.label: Angle Range (deg)
parameters.description: 0 = no rotation search.

parameters.name: pyramidLevels
parameters.label: Pyramid Levels (0=auto)
parameters.description: 0 derives a coarse-to-fine pyramid from the template size. 1 forces single-level search; models are cached by pixel content and levels.

parameters.name: maxTargets
parameters.label: Max Targets
parameters.description: Accepted matches. found/score/x/y/angle stay the best match. Default 1 keeps older single-result workflows.

parameters.name: minCenterDistance
parameters.label: Min Center Distance
parameters.description: 0 keeps every accepted center. A positive distance drops a later match whose center is closer than this to a better one.

parameters.name: duplicateOverlapThreshold
parameters.label: Duplicate Box IoU Threshold (0=off)
parameters.description: Suppress later template matches whose axis-aligned box IoU reaches this threshold; 0 disables overlap suppression.

parameters.name: scaleMinPercent
parameters.label: Scale Min
parameters.description: Uniform scale is a discrete resampled NCC search, not a continuous scaled model. 100 with Scale Max 100 keeps the original single-scale search. Use match.shape for trained scale.

parameters.name: scaleMaxPercent
parameters.label: Scale Max
parameters.description: Largest uniform scale to resample. Must be greater than or equal to Scale Min.

parameters.name: scaleStepPercent
parameters.label: Scale Step (%)
parameters.description: Ignored when min and max are both 100. At most 41 samples; widen the step or narrow the range if the search is rejected.

items.description: JLVision cached NCC pyramid matching with subpixel translation and rotation. Multiple matches use score-ordered box-IoU suppression by default; a search ROI, template mask, and discrete uniform scale range are optional. Defaults stay single-scale and single-result. This is not shape-based matching: there is no polarity ignore, clutter, deformation, or continuous scaled model. Use match.shape for those. Squared-difference mode verifies native NCC proposals using native SSD arithmetic. angle aligns the template with the image (positive = counter-clockwise).

parameters.name: caliperCount
parameters.label: Caliper Count
parameters.description: Number of radial calipers. Full circles distribute them without duplicating the end angle; partial arcs include both ends.

parameters.name: angleStepDeg
parameters.label: Angle Step (Legacy)
parameters.description: Fixed angular interval. Full circles omit the duplicate end ray; partial arcs sample from the start by this interval and may stop before the end.

parameters.name: radialBand
parameters.label: Radial Search Half-Width
parameters.description: Searches from max(0, nominal radius minus this value) to nominal radius plus this value; the radial search never crosses the center.

parameters.name: sampleWidth
parameters.label: Projection Length
parameters.description: The projection width must be odd; even values are rounded up to the next odd value (for example, 4 becomes 5). Length is averaged along the circle tangent; larger values smooth local noise but may merge nearby edges.

parameters.name: maxRadiusDeviation
parameters.label: Max Radius Deviation (0=off)
parameters.description: Reject each spoke before fitting when its edge radius is farther than this from the nominal radius.

parameters.name: minValidCalipers
parameters.label: Minimum Valid Calipers
parameters.description: Require at least this many edge points to remain after outlier rejection; increase it to prevent sparse arcs from producing a measurement.

parameters.name: maxFitOutliers
parameters.label: Max Fit Outliers
parameters.description: After an initial fit, discard up to this many points whose radial residual exceeds the threshold.

parameters.name: fitOutlierThreshold
parameters.label: Fit Outlier Threshold
parameters.description: Maximum allowed point-to-circle residual before a point can be excluded from the refit.

parameters.name: fitRadiusTolerance
parameters.label: Fit Radius Tolerance (0=off)
parameters.description: Reject the fitted circle when its radius differs from the nominal radius by more than this amount.

parameters.name: maxFitError
parameters.label: Max Fit Error (0=off)
parameters.description: Return found=false when the final radial RMS fit error exceeds this value; zero disables this quality gate.

items.description: Caliper circle measurement with selectable radial sampling, edge direction, bounded outlier rejection, and an optional maximum fit-error quality gate. Measurements use 8-bit grayscale; UInt16 input is scaled linearly from its full range to 0..255. Each radial segment is clipped to the image while preserving its direction. Optional rigid px-to-px transform maps the reference circle input/nominal center and arc angles into the current image; do not also supply an already corrected circle. ROI inputs are already in current image coordinates. Without transform the optional circle input is used directly in the current image. The minimum valid caliper gate is checked after outlier rejection.

parameters.name: sampleWidth
parameters.label: Projection Length
parameters.description: The projection width must be odd; even values are rounded up to the next odd value (for example, 4 becomes 5).

items.description: Single-caliper grayscale edge location along a configurable search line. Measurements use 8-bit grayscale; UInt16 input is scaled linearly from its full range to 0..255. Select edge polarity and search order, refine to subpixel, and optionally mask with ROI. No qualified edge returns found=false. Optional rigid px-to-px transform maps reference searchLine/endpoint parameters and sampling direction into the current image.

parameters.name: sampleWidth
parameters.label: Sample Width
parameters.description: The projection width must be odd; even values are rounded up to the next odd value (for example, 4 becomes 5).

parameters.name: edgeLength
parameters.label: Caliper Span (0=auto)
parameters.description: Spread of parallel profiles along the expected edge; zero uses the search-line length.

parameters.name: caliperCount
parameters.label: Caliper Count
parameters.description: Number of parallel search profiles along the edge span.

parameters.name: minValidCalipers
parameters.label: Minimum Valid Calipers
parameters.description: Require at least this many edge points to remain after outlier rejection; the default preserves the three-point fit minimum.

parameters.name: maxFitOutliers
parameters.label: Max Fit Outliers
parameters.description: Ignore up to this many edge points when their orthogonal residual exceeds the threshold.

parameters.name: fitOutlierThreshold
parameters.label: Fit Outlier Threshold
parameters.description: A point can be excluded when its distance from the fitted line exceeds this value.

parameters.name: maxFitError
parameters.label: Max Fit Error (0=off)
parameters.description: Return found=false when the final orthogonal RMS fit error exceeds this value; zero disables this quality gate.

items.description: Caliper line measurement with orthogonal RMS fit error, bounded outlier rejection, and an optional maximum fit-error quality gate. Measurements use 8-bit grayscale; UInt16 input is scaled linearly from its full range to 0..255. Out-of-image profiles are clipped without changing their direction and the visible profile lines are shown in the result. Green points were used for the fit; orange points were ignored. Optional rigid px-to-px transform maps reference searchLine/endpoint parameters and the parallel sampling layout into the current image. ROI inputs are already in current image coordinates. The minimum valid caliper gate is checked after outlier rejection.

parameters.name: maxCenterDistance
parameters.label: Max Centre Distance (0=off)
parameters.description: Optional concentricity tolerance in px; withinTolerance reports centreDistance <= limit (always true when off).

items.description: Two-dimensional offset between fitted circle centres. Returns centre distance, diametral offset (twice the distance), the A-to-B offset vector and an optional tolerance verdict, all in image pixels. Radii do not affect the centre-offset calculation. Emits JSON diagnostics with offset angle.

Return center distance and signed edge-to-edge gap between two circles; overlap produces a negative gap. Classifies the relation as separate, tangent, overlapping or contained and emits JSON diagnostics.

Circular wall model from fitted inner/outer circles. Sample radial rays from the inner centre; min/max are analytic extrema, mean/deviation use samples. The inner disk must be contained by the outer disk. Noncontainment returns found=false and omits thickness values. Units are pixels.

Pixelwise CIE76 Euclidean distance in sRGB/D65 Lab. Compare an aligned same-size reference image or a constant sRGB color. deltaE is the mean of pixel distances, not distance between mean colors. domainImage retains the effective inspection region for downstream thresholding; empty regions omit scalar differences.
Return the number of items in a DetectionList, with an isEmpty flag and JSON diagnostics. The list is validated for finite geometry before counting.
Extract one DetectionList item as typed scalar and geometry outputs, including optional confidence and classId; an out-of-range index returns found=false.

parameters.name: index
parameters.label: Index
parameters.description: Used when Select = by index (clamped).

items.description: Fit an ellipse to a contour (needs >= 5 non-collinear points). Output is the rotated rectangle of the ellipse: width = major axis, height = minor axis, angle = major-axis direction (degrees, CCW).

Filter DetectionList items by area, circularity, optional confidence and class ID with strict finite/ordered bound validation; missing optional values do not match configured filters. Emits kept count, rejected count and JSON diagnostics.

parameters.name: maxRmsError
parameters.label: Max RMS Error (0=off)
parameters.description: Optional quality gate: fail when the robust fit RMS residual exceeds this value.

items.description: Robust geometric circle fit (algebraic start, Gauss-Newton refinement, MAD outlier rejection) from at least three connected Point2D inputs (up to 12). Outputs RMS/max radial residuals and the inlier point count.

parameters.name: maxRmsError
parameters.label: Max RMS Error (0=off)
parameters.description: Optional quality gate: fail when the robust fit RMS residual exceeds this value.

items.description: Robust total-least-squares line fit (Tukey outlier rejection) from two or more connected Point2D inputs (up to 12). Outputs RMS/max perpendicular residuals and the inlier point count.

Native 256-bin histogram over the union of selected pixels intersected with the image domain. Connect exactly one of image/domainImage; optional region restricts it further. 8-bit color converts to gray. Percentiles use the first occupied level whose cumulative count reaches p% (p=0 gives the minimum); entropy uses log2. Empty selection returns zero arrays and omits statistics.

Find the largest blob and return typed geometry plus shape features (circularity, bounding-box size). blobs JSON lists every blob at or above Min Area, largest first; no qualifying blob returns found=false instead of failing.

parameters.name: maxAngleErrorDeg
parameters.label: Max Angle Error deg (0=off)
parameters.description: Optional parallelism tolerance; withinTolerance reports |angleError| <= limit.

items.description: For two fitted line segments, report the acute angular error from parallel (degrees), the measured inter-line angle and the endpoint drift of B perpendicular to datum A (pixels). Drift depends on B length. Endpoint reversal does not change results. Optional angle tolerance verdict and JSON diagnostics are included.

parameters.name: maxAngleErrorDeg
parameters.label: Max Angle Error deg (0=off)
parameters.description: Optional perpendicularity tolerance; withinTolerance reports |angleError| <= limit.

items.description: For two fitted line segments, report angular error from 90 degrees, the measured inter-line angle and endpoint drift of B along datum A (pixels). Drift depends on B length. Endpoint reversal does not change results. Optional angle tolerance verdict and JSON diagnostics are included. Geometry-only: uses the supplied fitted lines.

Sample segment A and intersect rays in both directions with segment B. Report mean/min/max/population deviation of absolute pixel distances. Parallel sampling direction is invalid; no overlap returns found=false. Not an image edge detector.

parameters.name: maxArea
parameters.label: Max Area
parameters.description: 0 disables the upper bound.

parameters.name: minCircularity
parameters.label: Min Circularity
parameters.description: 4*pi*A/P^2, 1 = perfect circle.

parameters.name: minWidth
parameters.label: Min Width
parameters.description: 0 disables the lower bound.

parameters.name: maxWidth
parameters.label: Max Width
parameters.description: 0 disables the upper bound.

parameters.name: minHeight
parameters.label: Min Height
parameters.description: 0 disables the lower bound.

parameters.name: maxHeight
parameters.label: Max Height
parameters.description: 0 disables the upper bound.

parameters.name: minRectangularity
parameters.label: Min Rectangularity
parameters.description: Area / bounding-box area, 1 = perfect rectangle.

items.description: Analyze either all filtered/sorted blobs or only the largest one. Filters combine area, circularity, bounding-box width/height and rectangularity (HALCON select_shape style); sorting supports area, X, Y and circularity. Outputs a DetectionList, the selected target geometry and source image; zero blobs is a normal result (count=0).

parameters.name: segment
parameters.label: Clamp to Segment
parameters.description: Clamp the projection to the finite segment; otherwise measure to the infinite line and report withinSegment separately.

items.description: Measure perpendicular distance to an infinite line or its finite segment. Emits unsigned and signed distance, projection parameter t, within-segment flag and JSON diagnostics; degenerate lines fail deterministically.

parameters.name: baseX
parameters.label: Base X
parameters.description: The pose at which the ROI parameter was authored.

parameters.name: anglePeriodDeg
parameters.label: Angle Period
parameters.description: Use 180 degrees for half-turn-symmetric locator models; use 360 degrees when orientation has a unique direction.

parameters.name: currentX
parameters.label: Current X
parameters.description: Used only when the currentPose port is not connected.

items.description: Rigid ROI correction after locating: p' = R(dTheta)(p - base) + current. Angle Period controls orientation symmetry (180 degrees for half-turn-symmetric models, 360 for directional models). Capture a reference image and its actual pose together before drawing the ROI. Rectangle ROIs become polygons when rotated. Feed roi into downstream ROI inputs and transform into measurement transform inputs so reference search geometry follows the workpiece as well. The output transform maps ReferenceImage→CurrentImage; compose it as A with a following crop transform as B to map reference geometry directly into CropImage coordinates. Do not transform already corrected geometry twice. Connect debugImage for reference capture and result overlays.

parameters.name: minArea
parameters.label: Min Area
parameters.description: Minimum contour area in px^2; contours below it are ignored and no accepted contour fails deterministically.

items.description: Minimum-area rotated rectangle around the largest accepted contour. Emits rectangle, centre, pose, angle, width/height, contour area, aspect ratio and JSON diagnostics; validates minArea and reports how many external contours were considered.

Compare already aligned polylines in the same pixel coordinates. Uniform arc-length samples are measured to reference segments with JLVision. deviation is the maximum sampled distance; mean/RMS pool both directions when symmetric=true. Sample budgets reject overflow rather than truncate. Missing/insufficient contours return found=false. Sampling can miss features between samples.

Fit a geometric least-squares circle with JLVision to one contour (at least six distinct points). Return max-minus-min sampled radii and RMS radial residual. Angular coverage is 360 minus the largest sample gap. Insufficient points, missing index or coverage below the limit returns found=false. Results depend on supplied contour sampling.

Fit a least-squares line with JLVision to one contour (at least three distinct points). deviation is the range of signed perpendicular residuals; rms and maxAbsError are relative to that fitted line. Supply one measured edge rather than the closed outline of a thick band. Units are pixels.

parameters.name: topN
parameters.label: Keep First
parameters.description: 0 keeps every item. Otherwise only the first N sorted items are returned and reindexed.

items.description: Sort a DetectionList by up to three fields and refresh result indices. Missing confidence or classId sorts last in either direction. Keep First limits the list after sorting. Emits count and JSON diagnostics.
Write one typed result value to JSON or a quoted CSV row.
Send an HTTP request. Cancellation/deadline abort the request; any non-2xx response fails the node.
Encode and persist an image using the extension-selected OpenCV codec. Paths are resolved by the host process.

parameters.name: blockSize
parameters.label: Block Size
parameters.description: Local window size (coerced to odd).

parameters.name: c
parameters.label: C Constant
parameters.description: Finite constant subtracted from the local threshold; larger values reduce foreground.

parameters.name: method
parameters.label: Method
parameters.description: Local statistic: plain mean or Gaussian-weighted mean. Unknown methods fail.

items.description: Local adaptive threshold for uneven illumination (color input is auto-converted to gray). Strictly validates method and C, and emits the foreground pixel ratio plus JSON diagnostics so binarization drift is visible without opening the image.

Extract small dark features with rectangular grayscale closing minus gray. Requires 8-bit input; color is converted to gray. Kernel dimensions must be odd in 1..255. Full-frame native border behavior; choose a kernel larger than the target feature.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.label: Channel
parameters.description: Channel to extract: gray/B/G/R, HSV hue/saturation/value, or average/max gray. Color/HSV channels require a color input; unknown values fail.

items.description: Extract one channel (gray/B/G/R or HSV H/S/V, plus average/max gray) as a single-channel image; color channels require a color input and unknown channels fail deterministically. Emits JSON diagnostics with channel and size.

Convert 8-bit sRGB/BGR(A) or replicated grayscale into three owned float32 channel images. RGB is 0..1; HSV is H=0..360 degrees and S/V=0..1; Lab uses D65 L*=0..100. Channels are scalar images, never packed pseudo-BGR.

Crop the visible intersection of a rectangle, circle, polygon, or brush ROI to its tight bounding box. Parts outside the image are clipped; a selection covering no image pixels fails clearly. A connected roi input overrides the local ROI parameters, so the crop can follow a corrected ROI each run. Brush supports add and erase strokes; roiMask outputs the binary selection, while croppedRoi outputs the same selection translated to crop coordinates and can connect to downstream measurement nodes to prevent masked crop boundaries from being detected as edges. cropOrigin is the crop top-left in input-image coordinates, and transform maps CurrentImage geometry to CropImage coordinates. Its transform can compose after roi.transform as A: ReferenceImage→CurrentImage, B: CurrentImage→CropImage. Legacy x/y/width/height parameters remain supported.

parameters.name: kernelSize
parameters.label: Kernel Size
parameters.description: Gaussian aperture (coerced to an odd value in 1-31 and reported in diagnostics).

parameters.name: sigmaX
parameters.label: Sigma X
parameters.description: 0 derives sigma from the kernel size.

parameters.name: sigmaY
parameters.label: Sigma Y
parameters.description: 0 mirrors sigmaX.

items.description: Gaussian blur for noise suppression before edge/blob analysis; kernel size is coerced to an odd value and reported. Validates finite, non-negative sigma values and emits JSON diagnostics with effective kernel, size and channels.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.label: Mode
parameters.description: Conversion mode: BT.601 luminance, channel average, or per-pixel channel maximum. Unknown modes fail instead of silently using luminance.

items.description: Convert a color image to single-channel gray for thresholding/measurement (single-channel input passes through unchanged). Strictly validates the mode and emits JSON diagnostics with input/output channels and size.

parameters.name: sigmaX
parameters.label: Sigma X
parameters.description: 0 derives sigma from the kernel size.

parameters.name: sigmaY
parameters.label: Sigma Y
parameters.description: 0 mirrors sigmaX.

items.description: Gaussian filtering suppresses general noise; median filtering removes salt-and-pepper noise while preserving edges. Kernel size must be odd.

parameters.name: kernelSize
parameters.label: Kernel Size
parameters.description: Median aperture (coerced to an odd value in 3-31 and reported in diagnostics); larger kernels remove stronger impulse noise.

items.description: Median filter: removes salt-and-pepper noise while preserving edges (odd kernel required). Emits JSON diagnostics with the effective kernel, image size and channel count.

Local grayscale range: rectangular dilation minus erosion. Returns owned 8-bit gray; color is converted to gray. Kernel dimensions must be odd in 1..255. Gradient bands are kernel-dependent and are not subpixel edge positions.

Choose erode/dilate/open/close for binary-shape cleanup, or white top hat, black bottom hat and gradient for grayscale feature extraction. Grayscale modes convert color input to gray and use a rectangular odd-sized kernel.

Convert 8-bit input to gray and linearly stretch the native min/max or percentile bounds into the requested gray range, clipping outliers to that range. Uniform images pass through unchanged. Returns an owned 8-bit grayscale image.

Estimate a local mean background on 8-bit grayscale, clamp it by minBackground, then output image/background*targetMean as clipped 8-bit gray. The window should exceed the feature size. This is local illumination normalization, not a substitute for calibrated flat-field references.

parameters.name: invert
parameters.label: Invert
parameters.description: Invert the binary output (dark objects become foreground).

items.description: Automatic global threshold (Otsu) with the computed threshold exposed for traceability and illumination drift monitoring. Also emits the foreground pixel ratio and JSON diagnostics (auto-gray flag, threshold) for run-to-run comparison.
Rectify a four-corner quadrilateral into a rectangular image.

parameters.name: width
parameters.label: Width
parameters.description: Output width in pixels (1-16384).

parameters.name: height
parameters.label: Height
parameters.description: Output height in pixels (1-16384).

parameters.name: interpolation
parameters.label: Interpolation
parameters.description: Resampling interpolation; unknown values fail instead of defaulting.

items.description: Resize an image using an explicit interpolation method. Emits output dimensions, scale factors (in JSON diagnostics) and validates the size range deterministically.

parameters.name: angleDeg
parameters.label: Angle
parameters.description: Finite rotation angle in degrees (counter-clockwise positive in image coordinates via OpenCV).

parameters.name: expand
parameters.label: Expand Canvas
parameters.description: Grow the canvas so no corners are cropped; otherwise keep the input size.

items.description: Rotate around the image center; optionally expand the canvas to retain all pixels. Emits output dimensions, normalized angle (in JSON diagnostics) and rejects non-finite angles.
JLVision mean-based unsharp masking on 8-bit grayscale: image + amount*(image-localMean), clipped to 0..255. May amplify noise; amount=0 passes gray pixels through. Color input is converted to gray.

parameters.name: blockSize
parameters.label: Block Size
parameters.description: Local window size (coerced to odd).

items.description: Create a binary image with a manual, local adaptive, or Otsu threshold. Adaptive and Otsu modes convert color input to gray; the threshold output is present for manual and Otsu modes.

parameters.name: calibrationJson
parameters.label: Calibration JSON
parameters.description: Optional fallback when calibrationJson is not connected; accepts CameraCalibrationModel JSON from calibration.cameraIntrinsics.

parameters.name: intrinsicsAssetId
parameters.label: Intrinsic Asset ID
parameters.description: Optional immutable camera-intrinsic asset used to verify this model during workflow execution, publication, and production dependency checks.

items.description: Correct lens distortion with JLVision using native camera parameters or legacy Brown-Conrady coordinate maps. Intrinsics are scaled when image resolution differs. A pinned asset id/version is checked against calibrationJson during workflow execution, publication, and production dependency validation. Output pixels use an undistorted coordinate frame; create ROI and measurement geometry from this image because no pixel-coordinate transform is emitted.
Apply a nonsingular pixel-to-pixel affine transform with zero border. validRegion excludes unsupported border pixels; intersect it with inspection regions before reference comparison.

Extract small bright features with gray minus rectangular grayscale opening. Requires 8-bit input; color is converted to gray. Kernel dimensions must be odd in 1..255. Full-frame native border behavior; choose a kernel larger than the target feature.

parameters.name: preprocess
parameters.label: Preprocessing
parameters.description: Automatic tries original grayscale, Otsu, and adaptive threshold images.

parameters.name: tryInverted
parameters.label: Try Inverted Polarity
parameters.description: Retries with inverted pixels when no normal-polarity code is found; multi-code mode also searches inverted pixels.

parameters.name: adaptiveBlockSize
parameters.label: Adaptive Window Size
parameters.description: Odd local window size; reduced automatically for small images.

items.description: Decode QR/DataMatrix/PDF417/Aztec and supported 1D barcodes using ZXing.Net. Supports an image ROI, threshold fallback passes, optional inverted-polarity retries, and multiple symbols. Results include decoded text, format, source-image points, and the preprocessing pass; detected points are drawn on the image preview. text/format expose the first result.

Ordinal text comparison for OCR/barcode results. Connected text/expected override their fallback parameters. Optional outer whitespace trimming and culture-independent case folding; empty actual or expected fails unless allowEmpty=true. Maximum 65536 UTF-16 characters per input.

parameters.name: dataPath
parameters.label: Tessdata Directory
parameters.description: Directory containing language .traineddata files.

parameters.name: language
parameters.label: Language(s)
parameters.description: Tesseract language codes, e.g. eng or eng+chi_sim.

parameters.name: whitelist
parameters.label: Character Whitelist
parameters.description: Optional allowed characters, e.g. 0123456789 for numeric fields. Control characters are rejected.

parameters.name: blacklist
parameters.label: Character Blacklist
parameters.description: Optional forbidden characters (tessedit_char_blacklist). A character cannot be in both whitelist and blacklist.

parameters.name: upscale
parameters.label: Upscale Factor
parameters.description: Resize before OCR; small print often reads better at 2x. Word boxes are mapped back to source pixels.

parameters.name: invert
parameters.label: Invert Image
parameters.description: Enable for light text on a dark background.

parameters.name: minConfidence
parameters.label: Minimum Word Confidence
parameters.description: Words below this confidence are dropped; when > 0, text is rebuilt from the kept words.

items.description: Run Tesseract 5 OCR (OCRMax-style controls) on the image or a rectangular ROI parameter. Outputs full text, mean confidence, per-word JSON and per-character JSON (chars, from Tesseract box output; empty when the model produces none), with boxes in source pixels and 0-1 confidences. Font training/teaching is not supported; the configured tessdata directory must include each requested language model.

Compare text literally or validate it with a culture-invariant .NET regular expression. Connected values override their fallback parameters. Regex mode exposes matchedText and groupsJson; a bounded timeout prevents a slow pattern from blocking the workflow.

Culture-invariant .NET regex validation with a bounded timeout. Full-match mode anchors the entire input; otherwise return the first match. Named/numbered groups are JSON strings. Invalid expressions and timeouts fail execution; no match returns pass=false. Limits: 65536 input characters, 4096 pattern characters, 128 groups and 1 MiB group JSON.

Inclusive intersection of three color channel ranges within the image domain and optional region. HSV min1>max1 wraps through red (0 degrees); other ranges must be ordered. Hue is 0 for achromatic pixels; use a saturation minimum for hue inspection. Split connected components explicitly.
Union input region objects and split with JLVision native connectivity. Object indices are not tracking IDs. Empty input returns zero objects.
Fill enclosed holes in each JLVision region object without bridging disconnected objects or altering input runs.
JLVision attribute selection on existing objects; does not split objects. Chain filters for multiple criteria. Area counts pixels; anisometry is the equivalent-ellipse axis ratio.
Create a Region from an inclusive grayscale or three-channel color range. Connect exactly one image or domainImage; an optional region further restricts the selection.

Rasterize a connected or configured rectangle/circle/polygon/brush ROI into one native pixel region, clipped to the canvas. Brush strokes support ordered add and erase operations. Optional image supplies canvas dimensions only. Rectangle includes pixel centres in [x,x+width) and [y,y+height); circle and polygon use native rasterization. Missing ROI is an error. Zero rectangle size or circle radius is empty. Limits: 64 million canvas pixels, 1000 polygon points, coordinates within +/-32768.

Preserve owned image pixels and attach an explicit region domain. Repeated reductions intersect domains. Connect domainImage to region.fromThreshold; regular Image ports deliberately reject it to prevent silent domain loss.
Set operations on the unions of A and B. Both must use the same image dimensions and coordinate system. Difference is A minus B; split the result explicitly if needed.

Native inner or outer pixel boundary, including hole edges. Operates per object unless unionFirst=true removes internal overlaps first. Outer boundaries are clipped to canvas bounds. Output objects retain grouping; use connectedComponents to split them.

Native convex hull per region object. unionFirst=true computes a common hull, bridging gaps between objects. Fills concavities and holes; this is a pixel region, not a subpixel contour. Empty input remains empty.
Rectangular morphology per object, clipped to image bounds. Enable unionFirst to bridge different objects, then split connected components explicitly. Kernel dimensions must be odd.

Measure each existing region object, preserving pixel area and holes. propertiesJson contains all objects; scalar ports select index. Empty or out-of-range index returns found=false and omits scalar measurements. Orientation is degrees in image x-right/y-down coordinates.

Native binary skeleton per region object, or after union when unionFirst=true. Output is a pixel region mask; count is the number of nonempty region objects, not branches, endpoints or physical length. Small spurs and sampling effects remain visible.
Convert each existing region object to one detection, preserving pixel area, centroid and bounding geometry. Does not split or reorder objects. Connect to collection nodes or flow.forEach.
JLVision inclusive gray-range region. Connect exactly one image or domainImage. Color is converted to gray. Disconnected objects remain one region until connectedComponents.
Apply the same pixel-to-pixel affine convention as image.warpAffine using nearest-neighbor region rasterization. Preserve object boundaries and holes, clip to output bounds, and remove empty objects.
Execute a vendor-neutral RobotTarget2D using SendTarget/Move or the standard TargetReady→Execute→Busy→Complete/Error→Ack industrial handshake with timeout/retry policy.

Planar compensation for J4 rotation-center/TCP eccentricity: converts a desired TCP pose into the J4 pivot command pose using (TCP offset - pivot offset) rotated by the commanded angle. Validates all finite inputs; emits eccentricity magnitude and JSON diagnostics. Outputs a target only; it does not send motion to hardware.
Read the current planar robot pose and neutral handshake state from RobotManager. Vendor protocol objects remain outside Workflow Core.

Create a vendor-neutral RobotTarget2D from a pose already resolved into RobotBase (or another configured robot frame). Validates frame, finite pose/offsets and guidance mode; pick offset is applied in pose-local coordinates. Emits frame, unit and JSON diagnostics. Does not send motion to hardware.

parameters.name: op
parameters.label: Operation
parameters.description: Strictly one of add/subtract/multiply/divide; unknown operations fail instead of defaulting to add.

parameters.name: clampMin
parameters.label: Clamp Minimum
parameters.description: Lower bound used only by Clamp.

parameters.name: clampMax
parameters.label: Clamp Maximum
parameters.description: Upper bound used only by Clamp. Must be greater than or equal to Clamp Minimum.

items.description: Combine measurements. Add, subtract, multiply, divide, power, min, and max read a and b. Square root, absolute value, and clamp read a only. An unknown operation, division by zero, a negative square root, reversed clamp bounds, or a non-finite result fails instead of guessing. Emits JSON diagnostics with operands, operation and result.

parameters.name: value
parameters.label: Value
parameters.description: Finite constant within the signed 64-bit integer range; non-finite values fail deterministically.

items.description: Emit a constant number (with an integer variant and an isInteger flag) for comparisons, arithmetic and thresholds. Non-finite or out-of-range values are rejected instead of silently propagating; includes JSON diagnostics.

parameters.name: min
parameters.label: Min
parameters.description: Inclusive lower bound; reversed bounds are swapped and reported in diagnostics.

parameters.name: max
parameters.label: Max
parameters.description: Inclusive upper bound; must be finite.

parameters.name: invert
parameters.label: Invert
parameters.description: When true, pass means the value lies outside the inclusive window.

items.description: Inclusive range check. Reversed min/max are swapped and flagged in diagnostics. deviation is 0 inside the window and the signed distance outside it; clamped is the value limited to the window; margin is the signed distance to the nearest bound. invert flips pass only. Emits pass, inside, margin, deviation, clamped and JSON diagnostics.
